We all had a first time. When was the first time you played a Megadrive/Genesis? What were the first three games you played?
When did you first play the Megadrive/Genesis? What were the first three games you played?

My first time was on a Sega Genesis at a friend's house. It was 1989. He only had two games: Altered Beast and Buster Douglas Boxing. We didn't play the boxing game much, but we played the crap out of Altered Beast all the time.

Since those two games are my first and second, my third game played was Mickey's Castle of Illusion at another friend's house.

Those were the early days and the games looked like arcade games of the time, which was nothing short of amazing to see in someone's living room.

(By the time I got my own Genesis, Sonic 2 had come out and I had TONS of great games to choose from.)
